question.text: When was the Chicago Board of Trade (CBOT) established, marking the beginning of forward contracts in organized trading?

explanation.text: The Logic: The Chicago Board of Trade (CBOT) was established in 1848 and facilitated the trading of forward contracts on various commodities. The Trap: 1865 was the introduction of standardized futures contracts at CBOT; the other dates relate to other exchanges/instruments and not to CBOT's establishment. Note: The 1848 CBOT forwards covered various commodities per the workbook, not just agricultural commodities.
